info.name: Corebanking Starter API
info.description:
REST API for the corebanking-starter service (clients, savings, loans, transaction operations, reconciliation, references).

## Setup
- Set the `baseUrl` variable (default http://localhost:8084).
- Fill the id variables (`clientId`, `savingsAccountRef`, `loanAccountRef`, `productCode`, `operationId`, `transactionId`) as you create resources. Account/product refs accept either the local UUID or the accountNo/productCode.
- Idempotent write endpoints send an auto-generated `Idempotency-Key` header (Postman `{{$guid}}`).
- HTTP Basic auth is applied at the collection level (`authUser`/`authPass`, default `admin`/`admin`; override via ADMIN_USER/ADMIN_PASSWORD env on the server). Live docs: `{{baseUrl}}/swagger-ui.html` and `{{baseUrl}}/v3/api-docs`.
